# record is not worth a lost one. collectors/gen_detail_hop_upgrade.py

# absent) was merged with the local branch: the hpengine form here is the merged
# one, page_walk included. 23 of the 37 rows the two branches disagreed on still
# stored less on hpengine and were moved back; 14 stored the same or more and
# stayed on hpengine with their detail hop.
